Первого поринга не забывает никто. Особе: No one forgets their first Poring. Especially if the Poring remembers them.
Пронтера, столица Рун-Мидгарда, просыпае:
Prontera, capital of Rune-Midgard, wakes to the ringing of cathedral bells. Beyond the South Gate lie the fields where rookies from the training camp first take up arms: swatting Fabres, chasing Lunatics and learning not to fear Porings.

This spring the Porings stopped being docile. They gather in packs, drag everything shiny into the thicket and run toward the village as if something were driving them. Captain Garret is rounding up everyone who can hold a weapon — even those who hold it wrong.
Поринг — первое чудовище любого новичка: The Poring is every rookie's first monster — and the first one they underestimate. The pink jelly eats anything that falls in the grass: apples, coins, forgotten boots. Old shepherds say that when there are too many Porings, they merge into one — and that big one remembers everything the little ones swallowed.
из путевых записей стражника южных ворот: from the travel notes of a South Gate guard
Весной поринги южных лугов взбесились, и: In spring the Porings of the South Fields went wild, and Captain Garret sent three rookies into the field: Alan, Bran and Vika. The squad crossed the fields from the village fence to the moonlit glade, hired mercenaries at The Two Bells and realized the Porings were driven not by hunger but by someone else's will. The Grey Hood, who had stolen the bell of Bruno the tavern keeper, slipped away from the chase like fog. The bell turned up in the belly of Mastering, King of Porings — next to the tavern keeper's daughter Greta, who had spent three hours in the jelly. Greta came out angry, with the bell, and in the squad. A horned sign showed black on the bell. Captain Garret looked at it and stayed silent a long while, then sent the squad down — into the culverts under Prontera, where the grey one had gone.
Доска прибита к изгороди у самой деревни: A board nailed to the fence at the edge of the village, letters daubed in tar, big and angry: “Do not feed the Porings. Especially apples. Especially Alan.” Below, someone added in chalk: “Alan, this means you.”
Кто-то в деревне хорошо знает Алана. Под: Someone in the village knows Alan well. I suspect the whole village.
Зацепился за гвоздь изгороди на высоте п: Snagged on a fence nail at shoulder height. The wool is fine and costly — neither shepherds nor guards wear anything like it. It smells of incense, like the cathedral, and of damp, like a cellar whose windows haven't been opened in ages.
Ладан — это из церкви. А сырость… сырост: Incense is from the church. But the damp… the damp is definitely not from the church.
Листок, приколотый к двери мельницы: «Пр: A note pinned to the mill door: “Missing this week: spoons — 14, horseshoes — 3, goat bell — 1, buckle off my holiday belt — 1, buttons — lost count. Goat is fine. Whoever returns it all gets a sack of flour. Whoever returns the buckle gets two.”
Четырнадцать ложек. Всё блестящее и всё: Fourteen spoons. Everything shiny, everything jingly. These aren't thieves, they're collectors.
Посреди лунной поляны — старый пень, и н: In the middle of the moonlit glade stands an old stump, and a sign is burned into its cut: a circle with a horned head inside. The embers beneath are still warm. The grass around it has gone grey as winter, and the Porings give the spot a wide berth.
Рогатый знак. Будто его рисовали не для: A horned sign. As if it wasn't drawn for us, but for someone below.
The dead know no hunger. Only memory.
За рекой забвения нет ни ночи, ни дня —:
Beyond the river of oblivion there is neither night nor day — only fog and silence. Somewhere within it the Lord of Death is raising an army to lead his subjects to the sun, and the gates that oaths held shut for a thousand years have been opened by the consent of one living man.

For the first time, Captain Garret marches with the squad. He is a veteran, and the dead will call to him first. He knows it. So does the squad.
Нифльхейм — земля, куда уходят все. Там: Niflheim is the land where all go in the end. Hel rules there, and there no one is hungry and no one hurries. Its gates close from within — so it was decided after the Great War, so that only one who chose to stay could guard them.
из летописи часовой башни Альдебарана: from the chronicle of Al De Baran's Clock Tower
В Нифльхейме Тео пел отряду в спину до с: In Niflheim, Teo sang at the squad's backs all the way to the river, Bran wrote names into the nameless graveyard, and Vika did not follow her mother's voice. The Grey Hood stood on the citadel wall: Ansgar, Vika's brother, said he would leave no one behind, and went to his son. The Lord of Death led his army toward the sun, but Greta rang the changing of the guard, and the dead lay down to sleep — little Til too. The sign on Ansgar's hand cracked, and he closed the gates from within himself, with the dead knights of Glast Heim; Captain Garret took up the post outside. Alan was knighted at the North Gate, and Bran reinstated his debts — with interest. A week later the pavement cracked in Morroc, and red light poured from the fissure. Thieves Guild couriers were seen nearby with a heavy crate.
На дне лодки — живые вещи: обручальные к: The bottom of the boat is full of living things: wedding rings, combs, a wooden horse, someone's tobacco pouch. The ferryman takes them from everyone who crosses, and says nothing. They say the dead leave here the last thing that held them to the other shore.
Тут на целую лавку. Не беру. Даже я не б: There's a whole shop's worth here. I'm not taking any. Even I'm not taking any.
Сотни камней, и ни на одном нет имени: м: Hundreds of stones, and not one bears a name: the dead of Niflheim forget their names. Bran walks the rows with a piece of charcoal, writing in the ones he knows. Mother first. Then the cobbler next door, his old arithmetic teacher, two guards from the South Gate.
Мама первая. Она всегда говорила: сначал: Mum first. She always said: write down your own first, then the rest.
На зубце стены цитадели лежит серая перч: On a merlon of the citadel wall lies a grey glove — thin, costly, dusty. Rolled up inside is a child's charcoal drawing: four people by a house, a sun in the corner. The smallest holds a wooden sword, the girl has a bandage on her hand. Captions: “For Papa. Til” and “Auntie Vika.”
Тиль нарисовал меня с бинтом. Мне было о: Til drew me with the bandage. I was eleven. My brother carried this with him for ten years.
Книга смен рыцарей Гласт Хейма: сотни ле: The duty book of the knights of Glast Heim: centuries, name after name. The last shift never came twenty years ago — the line is blank. Beneath it, in another hand, unsteady: “Capt. Garret, Prontera, would have taken it, had he made it.”
Смену так никто и не принял. Пора бы ком: No one ever took that shift. Time someone signed for it in the flesh.
Трон Владыки мёртвых: Throne of the Lord of Death
Что упало в канал Пронтеры, то принадлеж: Whatever falls into Prontera's sewers belongs to the bug.
Король велел вычистить стоки, и стража н:
The king has ordered the sewers cleared, and the guard is recruiting rookies — anyone who can hold a weapon and isn't afraid of rats. The culverts under Prontera are older than the city itself: sluices, brick vaults, ankle-deep water and an echo that answers before you finish speaking.

Veterans have gone down already. Their helmets are still somewhere below.

The Grey Hood left the Moonlit Glade not for the forest or the fields — he went under the cobbles. Greta's bell pulls that way like a dog on a leash, and for the first time its ring is not a cheerful one.
Под Пронтерой каналы старше самого город: The culverts under Prontera are older than the city itself. For centuries townsfolk have dropped coins, spoons and rings into the drains, and Thief Bugs haul it all to a single nest. They say that in the very depths lives a bug who remembers every coin — and every coin's owner. That's why, when someone in Prontera drops a copper through a grate, they don't curse — they say: “For the bug's crown.”
из записок сержанта Бертольда: from the notes of Sergeant Berthold
По королевскому указу отряд спустился в: By royal decree the squad went down into the Prontera Culverts to clear the drains of bugs. Below they found a spoon from The Two Bells, Otto's pushcart in pieces and six guard helmets by an open crate of black sand: the veterans had followed the voices the sand whispered. Bran checked the Morroc Thieves Guild's bill of lading: it listed twelve crates, but there were thirteen by the sluice. The Golden Thief Bug, stripped of its crown of coppers, tried to bargain for its life; Greta bargained more out of it. The squad came back one bigger: Dorn of Morroc, found behind a grate near the lair, swore he had opened his crate and refused to carry it any further. The empty thirteenth crate was marked: “Geffen, west, to the orcs.”
«Именем короля Пронтеры. Стоки кишат жук: “In the name of the King of Prontera. The drains are crawling with bugs, spoons are vanishing from cellars. Whoever goes down into the culverts armed and comes back out may call themselves an adventurer. Pay is per shell.” Below, in charcoal: “Berthold, we're going down. Back by supper.” Six signatures.
Шесть подписей — «к ужину». Сержант, нав: Six signatures — “back by supper.” The sergeant's probably still keeping their soup warm.
«Груз: ящики чёрные, 12 шт. Не открывать: “Cargo: black crates, 12 pcs. Do not open, do not shake, do not listen. Recipient — the grey one, at the third sluice. Payment on delivery. Courier: Dorn. If the courier opens a crate — don't look for the courier.” The seal: a dagger in a ring, the mark of the Morroc Thieves Guild.
Ящиков у шлюза тринадцать. Кто-то в гиль: There are thirteen crates by the sluice. Someone in the guild can't count. Or can count far too well.
Просыпалась из разбитого ящика на тропе: Spilled from a broken crate on the smugglers' path. Underground everything is cold and wet, but this sand is dry and warm as a palm. Hold it to your ear and it rustles, as if someone were whispering from far away — gently and insistently. You can't make out the words. Yet.
Колокольчик на него рычит, как пёс. Он н: The bell growls at it like a dog. It doesn't like this sand. Neither do I.
Нацарапано ножом на кирпиче в тупике, ак: Scratched with a knife into a brick at the dead end, neat as a ledger: “Dorn slept here. Debt — 4000. Remaining — 4000.” Below it, a row of tally marks by day, and beside them a crate, crossed out.
Долги пишет на стенах, а не на людях. От: He writes his debts on walls, not on people. Dad pours on credit for folks like that.
Вождь спускается к мёртвым один раз — чт: A chief goes down to the dead once — to promise them peace. The second time, he goes down to lie beside them.
К западу от Гефена бьют барабаны. Орки н:
Drums are beating west of Geffen. The orcs haven't come out onto the roads in forty years — now their patrols stand at every ford, and from the mines beneath the village comes a cold that summer never knows.

The empty thirteenth crate from the culverts pointed here: “Geffen, west, to the orcs.” Someone has already walked this road with black sand — and since then the dead in the orc lands have stopped sleeping.

Seeing the squad off, Garret said only: “Twenty years ago we walked this same road. The orcs warned us. We didn't listen.”
В Великой войне вожди орков поклялись де: In the Great War the orc chiefs swore to keep their dead underground for as long as the world stands. Each new chief goes down to the ancestors, sounds the horn and repeats the oath, then climbs back up and sounds it again. If the second horn isn't heard, it means the chief stayed below to hold them.
со слов шамана Угры, записано Лирой: as told by Ugra the shaman, written down by Lira
Отряд пришёл к оркам по следу тринадцато: The squad came to the orcs on the trail of the thirteenth crate. At the village gate they were met with axes: men in iron had come here once before, twenty years ago. Ugra the shaman told them of the chiefs' oath, and a lookout told of a man in grey at the mine entrance. Kai set the palisade on fire; Lira put it out. The Orc Hero tested the squad in the chief's circle, lost, and led them down, bringing his wounded out first. In the dungeon the ancestors rose, and on the ancient chief, the Orc Lord, a horned sign was burning. When the sign went out, the chief took up holding his dead once more and said before falling asleep: “The first knot is in the sands.” The lower watches laid down their arms. The orcs saw the squad off with drums. Kai noted that the drums beat softer now — as if the oath were sung in a whisper.
Столб из морёного дуба, резные морды пре: A post of bog oak, carved ancestor faces stacked one above another. Something has clawed at the lowest one, as if climbing up from under the ground. And over the orc runes, right on the brow of the topmost ancestor, a two-horned sign is traced in fresh black sand. The sand is still warm.
Колокольчик злится. Раньше он так только: The bell is angry. It only used to get this angry at Porings carrying stolen goods.
Восковая табличка студента Гефенской баш: A wax tablet belonging to a Geffen Tower student, its edges melted — clearly written right by the fire. “The shamans claim the dead ‘rose from below rather than woke up.’ Lira says that's unscientific. I say it's terrifying.” Below, in different handwriting: “Kai, don't write by the fire.”
Снизу, а не проснулись. Значит, кто-то в: From below, not woke up. So someone down there failed to hold them. Or stopped holding them.
Орки, люди и крылатые воины стоят плечом: Orcs, humans and winged warriors stand shoulder to shoulder against a huge horned shadow. Beneath the drawing is a row of handprints, from large to small: each new chief left his own. The last print is fresh and smeared, as if the hand had trembled.
Они дрались вместе. Когда-то все дрались: They fought together. Once, everyone fought together.
Турий рог в медной оправе, расколотый вд: An aurochs horn in a copper mount, split lengthwise. The chief sounds it when going down to the ancestors: once on the way down — and once climbing back up. The mount bears notches, one for every return. The last notch is missing. The horn sounded only once.
Он спустился держать их. Один. Никто не: He went down to hold them. Alone. No one followed.
Моррок, пески Сограта и пирамиды: Morroc, Sograt Desert and the Pyramids
Город назвали в честь того, о ком нельзя: The city was named after one whose name must not be spoken aloud.
Моррок живёт торговлей, ворами и тенью п:
Morroc lives on trade, thieves and the shadow of the pyramids. Heat shimmers over the rooftops, the bazaar sells dates, poison and other people's secrets, and here you lose your purse faster than your shadow at noon.

No one remembers why the streets are laid out in circles, or why old folk passing the well in the main square never look down. This spring the pyramid to the north awoke: mummies wander the sands, and a horned sign is carved on the stones by the oasis — the same one that was on the Orc Lord.

Dorn has come home. Home is not glad to see him, and he asks everyone not to set foot in any shops.
Говорят, фараоны Сограта ложились в гроб: They say the pharaohs of Sograt did not lie down in their tombs for rest. Each swore to lie there and never rise for as long as the one beneath the sand sleeps. The mummies at the doors are not guarding gold but guarding sleep. Thieves who forgot that are still in the corridors: some as wrappings on the wall, some as bones beneath it.
Отряд пришёл в Моррок по следу рогатого: The squad came to Morroc on the trail of the horned sign. Zara the thief, whom Set had framed for refusing to steal the pyramid key for the Grey Hood, led them through an old passage past the scorpion nests. At the Sandman wall Dorn himself showed them Set's letter — the guild would write off his debt in exchange for Greta's bell — and tore it up in front of everyone. In the sanctuary of Isis the bell put a mummy to sleep for the first time. In the tomb the pharaoh Osiris, freed from the sign, called himself a knot of the seal and named the other guardians: the fox in the east, the chief beneath the earth, the knights in the north. Greta rang him a goodnight. And when everyone turned away, grey smoke rose over the sarcophagus — and rang.
Ветер сдул песок со стены храма, и прост: The wind blew the sand off the temple wall, and a painting emerged: gods tall as columns lowering a huge horned figure into the earth. Above it, people lay stones — circle after circle, until a city forms. The figure has no face: the paint there was scraped away back in ancient times.
Круги. Как улицы Моррока. Кажется, я пон: Circles. Like the streets of Morroc. I think I get why the old folk don't look into the well.
В песке у стены — сургучная печать гильд: In the sand by the wall lies a wax seal of the Thieves Guild: a dagger in a ring. It was cut from an envelope carefully, with a knife. The guild seals its letters to debtors this way when it wants to settle things nicely. The envelope is nowhere to be found. Someone in the squad got mail in Morroc — and is keeping quiet for now.
Письма от гильдии у нас получает только: Only one of us gets letters from the guild. I'll wait for him to tell us himself. Not for long.
Пустой ящик у шакальих клеток, на дне —: An empty crate by the jackal cages, a handful of black sand at the bottom. The sand is warm, though the sun never reaches here, and if you listen, something rustles inside it like a whisper behind a wall. On the lid, a guild label: “Pyramid, lower level. Straight north.”
Такие ящики я таскал. Тяжёлые, будто вну: I used to haul crates like these. Heavy, like someone's sitting inside. Don't open it.
Строки древним письмом на крышке саркофа: Lines in ancient script on the sarcophagus lid, worn smooth by pilgrims' palms. Beside it, a copper plaque: the pyramid keeper once charged a copper to read them aloud. “I lay down so that he would not rise. Do not wake me. Whoever wakes me must put me back to sleep.”
Это не проклятие. Это просьба. Как у бол: It's not a curse. It's a request. Like a patient asking you not to touch the bandage.
While she sings, the dead dream.
В Пайоне фонари не гасят до рассвета: по:
In Payon the lanterns burn until dawn: it has been the custom under the tiled roofs ever since the mountain first took someone's children before their time. This spring there is no one left to put them out. One by one, people leave the village at night — barefoot, in their nightshirts, smiling, as if someone dear had called to them.

The forester went looking for the missing and never came back; a white wolf with a bow in its teeth was seen by his house. Osiris, falling asleep, said: “the fox in the east.” Someone very old is singing in the bamboo, and Greta's bell rings in reply — softly and rapidly, as if it were weeping.
Лиса, что поёт мёртвым: The Fox Who Sings to the Dead
В Пайоне фонари не гасят до рассвета. Го: In Payon the lanterns burn until dawn. They say the cave beyond the village is where those the mountain took before their time lie sleeping, and a nine-tailed fox guards their sleep. While she sings, the dead dream. If the song breaks off, they will remember the way home.
из путевых записей лесника Пайона: from the travel notes of Payon's forester
В Пайоне люди уходили из домов сами — на:
In Payon people left their homes of their own accord — following the voices of those they loved. The squad followed them through the moonlit forest edge, the empty village and the abandoned temple, where a dead abbot let the sleepers pass instead of stopping them. Among the will-o'-the-wisps Bran heard his mother, and Alan held his shoulder until the voice fell silent. At the Lantern Graveyard Vika read the last rites, and her hands did not shake.

Moonlight Flower, the fox spirit who for centuries had sung “sleep” to the dead of the cave, was singing “come to me” to the living: her kits had burned in a fire, and the Grey One had promised to bring them back. The sign crumbled. The fox sings “sleep” once more, the villagers returned home, and the forester woke up in the cave, alive. For the first time, Bran wrote down in his ledger a debt owed by himself. And the Grey One, the fox said, had been asking about a ship near Izlude.
Лежит на камне покинутого погоста — дере: It lies on a stone in the abandoned graveyard — wooden, with a chipped butterfly. It wasn't just found here: it was wiped clean. The moss by the stone is flattened, there are knee prints in the dust. Someone came here every night, sat down and polished the hairpin with a sleeve, the way you brush a child's hair before bed.
Так прибирают, когда ещё ждут. Не когда: That's how you tidy up when you're still waiting. Not when you've already said goodbye.
Листок на двери управы, почерком старост: A sheet on the door of the village hall, in the elder's hand: “Gone after a voice: Widow Liu — to her husband. The miller's son — to his mother. Smith Han — to his brother. The forester — to look for them all.” The lines grow more and more crooked. In the margin: “The gentleman in grey asked me to copy out the names. Polite.” The last line: “Elder Wei — to his daughter. Forgive me.”
He kept count to the very end. Even wrote himself down. I would have too.
Красная лента на вороте колодца плакальщ: A red ribbon on the windlass of the mourners' well — tied in a bow, double-looped, the way a bride's is tied before she steps out. The ribbon has faded to pink, but the knot is fresh: it has been retied many times. On the stone beside it, a cup of tea, still warm. The bride is still getting ready.
Тётушка Сун. Каждый вечер. Мы думали, он: Auntie Sun. Every evening. We thought she just liked this well.
В Пайоне говорят: если дождь идёт при со: In Payon they say: if it rains while the sun shines, the foxes are holding a wedding, and you mustn't watch or they'll lead you away. This spring the sunshower came three times, yet no one saw a wedding. The old women whisper: the forest's guardian has no one to lead beneath the lanterns — her kits burned.
Бабушка тоже рассказывала про лисью свад: Grandma told stories about fox weddings too. Only her foxes also demanded a dowry.
Излуд, Бьялан и затонувший корабль: Izlude, Byalan and the Sunken Ship
Море возвращает всё. Кроме того, что ему: The sea returns everything. Except what was given to it by contract.
Излуд — порт у самой Пронтеры: отсюда па:
Izlude is the port right by Prontera: ferries run from here to Byalan Island, and Swordmen from all over the kingdom come for the local arena. This spring fishermen see green lights under the water at night, and ships bound for Alberta never arrive.

The old-timers on the pier say it's Drake, the pirate who sold eternity for a cargo he swore never to give up. For a hundred years his frigate has lain on the seabed, guns loaded, crew at their stations. Greta's bell rings toward the sea with a muffled tone, as if someone were answering it from under the water in the same voice.
Сто лет назад капитан Дрейк взял на борт: A hundred years ago Captain Drake took a coffin aboard and accepted a payment that can never be spent — eternity. That same night his frigate sank to the bottom off Izlude. Ever since, the crew has stood at their stations, the guns loaded, and the captain waits for whoever comes for the cargo.
из записок смотрителя маяка Излуда: from the notes of Izlude's lighthouse keeper
Под Излудом отряд спустился к фрегату ка:
Beneath Izlude the squad descended to Captain Drake's frigate — in a rusty diving bell, with a bitter potion and Lira's ice bubble. The ship's log held an entry a century old: the cargo was the coffin of Helmut of Prontera, bellmaster and brother of Greta's great-great-grandfather, who had tried to ring his way through to his dead daughter. Drake had sworn never to give up that coffin, and the sign made him forget what he was guarding and sink everything that sailed past.

Greta rang over the coffin — not “come back,” but “sleep.” The twin bell answered one last time, cracked and fell silent forever. Drake asked her to ring for him too, and fell asleep. And Bran laid a map on the table: all the signs lined up in a single line, pointing north. The squad was never running late. It was being led.
The pages are swollen, but the ink holds. The last entry is a hundred years old: “Cargo received: the coffin of Helmut, bellmaster of Prontera. Handed over by the deceased's brother. Payment — eternity. Course — beyond the edge of the sea. Surrender to no one.” Below, in another hand: “The coffin rings at night. Don't tell the crew.”
Звенит… Значит, он и там звонил. Упрямый: Rings… So he kept ringing even down there. Stubborn. Runs in the family.
Лист из тетради долгов, расстеленный на: A page from the debt ledger, spread out on a barrel in the hold. Crosses mark every place where the horned sign went out: the Prontera fields, the orc mine, the pyramid, Payon Cave. Bran drew a single straight line through the crosses — and they all fell along it like beads on a string. The string runs north. This ship lies right on it.
Я счетовод, а не гадалка. Но цифры не вр: I'm a bookkeeper, not a fortune teller. But numbers don't lie: they scattered crumbs for us, and we pecked.
Закатилась под сундуки сокровищницы, сур: It rolled under the treasury chests, its wax sealed with two bells. Inside, a letter: “Helmut. I took you where no voice can reach. Forgive me for taking you. Don't forgive me if you come back. I named my daughter Greta — let at least her name live on in our home. Your brother.”
Вот почему нас всех зовут Гретами. А я д: So that's why we're all named Greta. And I thought great-great-grandpa was just too lazy to come up with anything.
Сквозь щель под цепями гроба видно: в сл: Through the gap under the coffin's chains you can see it: in Helmut's folded hands lies a bell of the same shape and weight as Greta's, only black, as if it had been held in fire. It hums on its own, without being struck — softly and insistently, like someone calling from the next room. It's been calling for a hundred years.
Мой укладывает, этот зовёт. Сто лет спор: Mine lulls, this one calls. They've argued for a hundred years. Time for someone to give in — and it won't be me.
Альдебаран и Часовая башня: Al De Baran and the Clock Tower
Time doesn't heal. Time keeps records.
Альдебаран живёт по часам: по ним открыв:
Al De Baran runs by the clock: by it they open the locks, brew potions and pay Kafra. Above the canals stands the tower, and its chimes can be heard in every courtyard.

But a week ago the tower clock started running backward, and no one in town can remember what happened yesterday. The Kafra greets visitors for the third time this morning, and the ink in the archive is fading.

The archivist asks for one thing: wind the tower. And Bran asks for another — find the page that records who opened the gates first.
Мастер башни Альдебарана поклялся записы: The master of Al De Baran's tower swore to record every hour of Midgard — and the tower records them still: wars, weddings, the price of apples. They say that if you wind it properly, it will tell you everything. If you wind it wrong, it will forget everything itself.
В Альдебаране часы шли назад, и город не: In Al De Baran the clocks ran backward, and for a week the city couldn't remember yesterday. The squad climbed the tower past Alarms and owls, went down to the archive and found that a “polite gentleman in grey” had been there: he had taken the volume “Twenty Years Ago” and left a grey hair behind. The Clock Tower Manager, branded with the horned sign, was replaying one night over and over — 3:13, the fall of Glast Heim. When he fell asleep, the clocks moved forward. Odo the archivist gave the squad two pages: the charter of Glast Heim's night watch and a record from twenty years ago, where next to Captain Garret's name stands a second name — Ansgar.
В книге о литье кто-то мелко записал на: In a book on casting, someone wrote small in the margins: “Bell metal of the Glast Heim cathedral. Tin, copper and a pinch of silver from the altar. Rings the changing of the guard — for the living and the dead.” Below is a drawing of a cracked bell with an arrow: “fragments — to the treasure hunters.”
Мой колокольчик — оттуда. Бабушка говори: My bell is from there. Grandma called it “the cathedral one,” and I thought that was just for show.
Листок из гильдии алхимиков, приколотый: A sheet from the Alchemist Guild, pinned to a shelf by the stairs: “Someone has taken a volume from the archive. The lock is intact, the dust untouched. A grey hair was left on the shelf — long, not an owl's. The volume's tag: ‘Twenty Years Ago.’ I ask the archivist to check the inventory.” There is no reply on the sheet.
Замок цел, пыль цела. Так ходят только т: Lock intact, dust intact. Only people who were let in walk like that.
Жёлтая карточка из ящика «Гласт Хейм», п: A yellowed card from the “Glast Heim” drawer, old handwriting, faded ink: “A feast at the lord's on the night of the fall. Guests — forty. One guest with no name: in grey, polite, came on foot, left before dawn.” At the bottom, a fresh note in another hand: “Verified.”
«Сверено». Кто-то проверял, записан ли о: “Verified.” Someone checked whether he was on record. So it matters to him that they remember here.
Страница летописи башни, строки ровные,: A page from the tower's chronicle, its lines as even as gears: “On the night Glast Heim fell, the tower clock stopped at 3:13. The lord of the city opened the gates of the night watch and let a guest in. The watch stood to the end. The watch stands still.” After that the page is blank — the tower fell silent for the first time.
Караул стоит и теперь… Значит, они до си: The watch stands still… So they're still there. All these years.
Гласт Хейм, город-замок рыцарей: Glast Heim, Castle City of Knights
Пост у северных ворот не оставлять. Даже: Do not abandon the post at the North Gate. Not even on the lord's orders.
Гласт Хейм стоит на холме, как стоял все:
Glast Heim stands on its hill as it always has: towers, cathedral, a crest over the gates. Only its windows have not been lit for many hundreds of years, and faceless sentries walk the walls in silence.

Captain Garret led the squad to the gates and stopped. Twenty years ago he entered here with eleven of his men. He came out with one — on his shoulders. Now he knows his name. And, it seems, knows where he is now.
Караул, которого не сменили: The Watch That Was Never Relieved
Гласт Хейм пал за одну ночь: вечером в з: Glast Heim fell in a single night: in the evening music played in the castle, and in the morning no one came out of the gates. But the watch at the North Gate did not leave. The dead knights relieved one another by the charter for many centuries more — until one day the relief never came. They say they still stand watch, only they've forgotten whom they're guarding against.
В Гласт Хейме отряд прошёл склепы, оруже: In Glast Heim the squad passed through the crypts, the armory and the bell tower, where the cracked cathedral bell answered Greta's bell like kin. Garret's lieutenant had held the bridge for twenty years and received a token instead of an order. At the altar Vika recognized the High Priest as Father Benedict, the man who raised her, and let him go — the way he himself had taught her. Dying, he confessed: the Grey Hood is her brother Ansgar, alive. On the gallery Vika saw him herself. The Dark Lord fell in the churchyard, laughing: he was only a gatekeeper, the key lay with the horned one in the forest, and the Lord's sign is borne on the hand of Ansgar — the squire the captain once carried out of here on his shoulders. Captain Garret buried ten of his knights and, for the first time in twenty years, spoke of them aloud.
На стене оружейной углём выведены двенад: On the armory wall, twelve names are written in charcoal — the Prontera guard squad that entered Glast Heim twenty years ago. Ten are crossed out neatly, one at a time, as if someone came here for years. Two remain: “Capt. Garret” and “Squire Ansgar.”
Кто-то вёл этот счёт двадцать лет. Аккур: Someone kept this count for twenty years. Neat handwriting. Not a kind one.
На колокольне висит соборный колокол с р: In the belfry hangs a cathedral bell with a horned sign on its side. Greta's bell answers it with a soft chime, like kin. The edge of the chip is fresh by stone standards: a hundred years ago a piece was broken off the bell — just enough for one little bell.
Бабушка говорила: колокольчик старше тра: Grandma used to say the bell is older than the tavern. Turns out it's older than Grandma too.
На скамьях капеллы вырезаны сорок детски: Forty children's names are carved into the chapel pews — that's how the orphanage marked seats so no one got lost. Among them — “Vika.” One name is carved with a different knife, deeper and uneven: “Til, son of Ansgar.”
Это моя скамья. Третья слева. Я думала,: This is my pew. Third from the left. I thought they burned it long ago.
На двери караульни прибит медный лист, п: Nailed to the guardhouse door is a copper sheet, green with age: “Do not abandon the post at the North Gate. Not even on the lord's orders.” Below are hundreds of notches from relieved watches. The last notch is twenty years old. After that, nothing.
Мы дошли сюда в ту ночь. Смену так никто: We made it here that night. No one ever took the shift.
Лабиринтный лес, в двух часах от Пронтер: Labyrinth Forest, Two Hours from Prontera
Бафомет не дерётся с теми, кто пришёл то: Baphomet doesn't fight those who come to bargain. He just never lets them go.
Лабиринтный лес лежит в двух часах пешко:
The Labyrinth Forest lies two hours' walk from Prontera. Townsfolk go there for firewood and are back by lunch — if they stick to the edge. Whoever ventures deeper will keep coming out at the same glade until they agree to a deal.

The Dark Lord said: the key lies with the horned one in the forest. The squad goes after a key that may already have been turned.
Говорят, в сердце леса живёт козлоголовы: They say a goat-headed one with a scythe lives in the heart of the forest, and every path leads to him. He takes nothing by force — he only buys. The price is always fair. It's just that paying it takes longer than the buyer lives.
из путевых записей Янека (все тридцать л: from the travel notes of Janek (all thirty years of them)
В Лабиринтном лесу каждый получил предло: In the Labyrinth Forest everyone got an offer they couldn't refuse. Alan was offered a shield without the lesson, Bran — his mother and a farm free of debt, Dorn — a clean slate with the guild, Vika — her brother without the sign, Greta — that first Greta, Helmut's daughter. Everyone refused; Greta haggled so hard the demon lost his patience. In the Ring of Stones Ansgar asked Greta for the bell and didn't get it. Baphomet fell, but he no longer had the key: the living man who signed the contract had given his consent to the dead. The gates of Niflheim are open. Janek, who had sought a way out for thirty years, walked out along a straight path. Captain Garret marched with the squad for the first time.
Лист коры, исписанный углём: тридцать ле: A strip of bark covered in charcoal: thirty years of paths, drawn one over another. The paths wind, split, dive into ravines — and every last one converges on a single glade. Beneath it, a note: “Don't go.” And twenty more times, smaller and smaller: “Don't go.”
Двадцать раз «не ходить» — и все двадцат: Twenty times “don't go” — and all twenty times he went. I know a debtor's handwriting when I see it.
На стволе старого дуба — зарубки, по пят: On the trunk of an old oak there are notches, five to a row. Thousands of them: thirty years, day after day. Lower down, where the bark is softer, someone has scratched: “Out?” And below, in the same hand, only older: “No.”
Он спрашивал себя каждый день. И каждый: He asked himself every day. And every day he answered honestly.
На пне посреди Леса зеркал лежит деревян: On a stump in the middle of the Forest of Mirrors lies a wooden sword with a notch on the hilt — “so nobody mixes them up.” Alan whittled himself a sword like this at seven, and it burned along with the shed. Beside it is a price tag in neat handwriting. No one read it aloud.
Мой. Не трогайте. Это не подарок — это в: It's mine. Don't touch it. It's not a gift — it's a shop window. He's showing off the goods.
Лист тонкой кожи, пахнет серой. «Я, Ан…,: A sheet of thin skin that smells of sulfur. “I, An…, will open the gates from this side. In return — my wife and son.” The signature is rubbed out, as if a finger had worn at it for a long time. A grey hair is stuck to the wax. Beneath Baphomet's seal is a second one, extinguished: the horned sign.
Ан… Ансгар. Жена и сын — Мира и Тиль. Сх: An… Ansgar. Wife and son — Mira and Til. It adds up. I wish it didn't.
